title: Final speed in region II
description: Essential: Correctly applies energy conservation to derive v2 = sqrt(v1^2 - 2V0/m).

title: Snell's law for refraction
description: Essential: Derives or states the law n1 sin(i1) = n2 sin(i2) from Fermat's principle.

title: Action-phase relationship
description: Important: Correctly relates phase change to action change: Δφ = (2π/h) ΔA.

title: Path slope derivation
description: Important: Correctly derives dy/dx = -sqrt((n(y)/(n0 sin(i0)))^2 - 1) using the constant from Snell's law.

title: Beam trajectory integration
description: Important: Correctly integrates to find x = (n0/k) ln((n0 - ky)/n0 + sqrt(((n0 - ky)/n0)^2 - 1)).

title: Phase difference calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates β from given geometry and de Broglie wavelength, yielding a numerical value (~5.13).

title: Null detection distance
description: Important: Correctly applies approximation to find Δy for destructive interference (~ -16.2 μm).

title: Minimum flux density
description: Important: Correctly calculates I_min from volume, speed, and one-electron condition (~4e19 m^-2 s^-1).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in slope expression dy/dx or in the integrated trajectory for x.

title: Algebraic manipulation error
description: Pitfall: Makes an error in relating v2 to angles (v2 = v1 sinθ1 / sinθ2) or in energy conservation.
